answer.summary: Chris says a podcast gives you a natural way to talk with knowledgeable people and explore your curiosity about a subject in depth—an opportunity that can feel awkward to request without the podcast.

sections.heading: A platform to learn by asking experts
sections.content: A podcast gives you a reason to invite someone smart for an hour and ask questions to understand a topic. Chris’s example was Morgan Housel: after reading The Psychology of Money and having many questions, he emailed Housel to ask if he could pick his brain for an episode—something Chris says he would not have felt comfortable asking for as a random conversation.
